simple.summary: חַלָּה (challâh) means a cake (as usually punctured ) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 6 19.

definitions.full: H2471. challah חַלָּה noun feminine a kind of cake (probably as perforated , see Di Lev 2:4 ) — ׳ח absolute Num 15:20 ; Lev 24:5 ; construct חַלַּת Exod 29:23 4 t.; plural חַלּוֺת Lev 2:4 2 t.; חַלֹּת Exod 29:2-3 t. — used in offerings: 1 at the sacrif . of David on removal of ark, given to each person as part of peace-offering 2Sam 6:19 . 2 elsewhere only P (H Lev 24:5 (twice in verse)): a. of the 12 cakes of the table of the holy place , made of סלת Lev 24:5 (twice in verse). b. made of ערסת ראשׁית as an offering of first-fruits Num 15:20 . c. of שׁמן לחם , to be burnt with the עוֺלָה Exod 29:23 = Lev 8:26 . d. of מַצָּה burnt on the altar with c. Lev 8:26 , but usually to be eaten by participants in the several forms of peace- offering Num 6:19 , and such mingled with oil Exod 29:2 ; Lev 2:4 ; 7:12 (twice in verse); Num 6:15 . e. ׳ח חמץ לחם to be used by the offerer in connection with the unleavened cakes of d. Lev 7:13 .
